jobs.description:
Zertificon Solutions – Software Manufacturer since 2004.
We are IT security specialists: our products encrypt business communications. More than 25% of the 100 highest-revenue companies in Germany, as well as hundreds of medium-sized enterprises across all industries, already use our Z1 encryption solutions. We have big plans and continue to grow steadily. Nearly 140 employees are already working with us in Neukölln. Join our professional, highly qualified team: take on challenges, share your knowledge, learn new things, and discover your potential!

Your tasks

We are looking for a Technical Product Owner with a strong technical mindset to drive the evolution of our Z1 Appliance – the virtual foundation for our server-based security products and services. The Z1 Appliance is a core part of our B2B offering: Historically based on Debian Linux, it is now evolving into a modern container-based platform

- As the central interface between development and business teams, you gather requirements from stakeholders and the market and translate them into clear project specifications
- In alignment with our company goals and in close collaboration with the business teams, you develop and own the vision and roadmap for your platform components
- You break down complex feature ideas into epics and user stories with clear acceptance criteria
- You keep the backlog consistently up to date and well prioritized for your development team
- To ensure strong usability, you create lightweight mockups yourself and coordinate mockups and prototypes for larger features with our UI/UX designers
- You conduct market and competitive analyses to support the platform strategy
- You maintain technology partnerships with virtualization and cloud infrastructure providers and build new collaborations

Your profile

- You have at least 2 years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or in a similar role within an agile team
- You bring a strong technical understanding
- Writing epics, user stories, and bug reports comes naturally to you
- You are familiar with Debian Linux as well as modern technologies such as microservices, container technologies (Docker Swarm, Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructures
- Concepts such as clustering, load balancing, multi-tenancy, storage services, and high availability are not new to you
- Very good English skills (at least C1) enable smooth collaboration in international teams   

Nice to Have:

- Understanding of the design and operation of SaaS infrastructures
- Hands-on experience with UX mockup tools such as Figma or Adobe XD
- German language skills

cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools,
outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare & cleaning products. Our
focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the industrial,
construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home improvement,
repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio includes
MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® ̶ recognized worldwide for their deep
heritage and innovative product platforms of superior quality. The
company maintains a global manufacturing and product development
footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately US$15.2
billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring exceptional people
is a top focus at TTI. This drives a high-performance culture across
all levels of our organization and helps to achieve our vision of
being number one in the industries we serve. Our unique high-speed
decision-making process supports our acute focus on developing
superior products and meeting high customer expectations. We view our
winning culture as a competitive advantage that powers our growth. As
part of a structured succession planning process at our Winnenden
(Stuttgart area) site, we are looking for a Controller (m/f/d)
European Logistics & Supply Chain Finance who is motivated to take on
increasing responsibility and further develop their career within an
international environment. In this role, you will work closely with
the current Team Lead and gain comprehensive insight into the
financial steering of our European logistics organization. Over time,
you will be systematically introduced to broader responsibilities and
leadership-related tasks. This position offers a clear perspective to
assume the Team Lead role for European Logistics & Supply Chain
Finance in the future as part of our long-term succession planning.
Your responsibilities: Logistics cost controlling: partner closely
with the logistics organization to perform budget-to-actual analyses,
ad hoc evaluations, scenario analyses, and management reporting
Budgeting & forecasting: prepare annual budgets, periodic forecasts,
and financial outlooks Closing activities: support month-end and
year-end closing processes Management reporting: prepare, analyze, and
continuously improve monthly management reports and KPIs Support the
strategic planning of European logistics operations and develop
business cases for the development of the European warehouse footprint
Inventory controlling: analyze inventory levels, inventory variances,
rework and scrapping activities to track financial impacts and
identify risks and opportunities Projects & process improvements:
participate in international and cross-functional projects with a
focus on enhancing controlling processes, reporting standards, and
digital tools Leadership exposure: collaborate closely with the
current Team Lead, gaining insight into leadership responsibilities,
stakeholder management, and strategic decision-making processes Your
profile: Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Business
Informatics, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable qualification
Relevant experience in Controlling, Finance, or a related analytical
business partnering role, ideally in an international environment
Business analytical skills, interest in numbers and data, and the
expertise to translate financial insights into business
recommendations Competent knowledge of Excel and BI tools; SAP
knowledge as a plus Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented
working style combined with collaboration skills Communication and
stakeholder management skills across different organizational levels
Interest in taking on additional responsibility and developing toward
a leadership position Good command of German and English Willingness
to travel according to business need within Europe What we offer: An
interesting position with an attractive company––recognized as a
"top employer” by kununu A genuine succession opportunity: This
position has been created as part of a long-term succession plan. You
will work closely with the current Team Lead and be systematically
prepared for broader responsibilities and a potential future
leadership role. A challenging and impactful role within an
international organization and a highly motivated team The opportunity
to actively shape and further develop our European Logistics & Supply
Chain Finance Controlling organization Flexible working hours, hybrid
working options, and 30 days of annual leave Capital-forming benefits
and company pension scheme EGYM Wellpass corporate fitness membership
Employee discounts, JobRad bicycle leasing, complimentary fruit, water
and coffee, and additional attractive benefits Are you interested?
Then send your application stating your earliest possible starting
date and your salary expectations to jobs@tti-emea.com or apply
directly via our careers page. Naturally, we will treat your
application with the utmost discretion. We look forward to getting to
know you! Techtronic Industries ELC GmbH Human Resources – Agnese

jobs.occupation: (Senior) Finance Manager (m./w./d.) (Leiter/in - Finanz- und Rechnungswesen)
jobs.description:
About us JUNA is on a mission to #electrifyroadfreight. Founded in
2023, we’ve had a strong start and have already deployed a
significant fleet of heavy-duty electric trucks in Europe. Our
innovative business model makes it easy and low-risk for carriers to
shift to electric logistics by offering electric trucks as a service,
a flexible pay-per-kilometer pricing structure, and access to
guaranteed utilization from large shippers. As a joint venture between
industry leaders Scania and sennder, JUNA gives customers access to
premium electric trucks and reliable revenue through access to
priority green freight. Your mission As JUNA’s (Senior) Finance
Manager, you will own the full reporting cycle across our European
entities — ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery of
financial information as we scale. You’ll work closely with external
accounting partners in multiple countries and oversee monthly
shareholder reporting. Take ownership & drive the month-end closing
process by preparing and reviewing key accounting information and
collaborating closely with external accountants to finalize the
monthly financial records. Prepare monthly accruals. Support in
preparing monthly shareholder reporting (e.g. OPEX, Vehicle P&L).
Manage communications with external accounting offices in Italy,
Netherlands, Poland, Belgium, France, and Spain. Assist external
accountants with preparation of annual reports and third-party audits.
Prepare & issue client invoices, track payment status and proactively
follow up on overdue payments. Continuously improve, streamline and
automate finance processes to drive scalability of the finance
function. What That Looks Like In the first 3–6 months: Ramp Up
Quickly: Become fully onboarded into JUNA’s finance systems and
tools, building a solid understanding of our entity structure and
reporting flows. Own Core Processes: Independently complete your first
solo month-end close accurately and on time. Build Key Relationships:
Establish reliable, trust-based working relationships with our
external accounting offices across Europe. After 12 months: Seamless
Collaboration: Work in sync with external accounting teams across all
JUNA entities, ensuring smooth coordination and minimal friction.
Trusted Owner: Be recognized as a proactive, reliable owner of the
full reporting cycle and balance sheet — the go-to person for
financial accuracy and compliance. Process Champion: Have identified
and implemented improvements to finance workflows, contributing
meaningfully to JUNA’s operational scalability. Your profile What
you bring: Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a closely related field,
coupled with 7+ years of professional experience in a relevant role.
Comfort working with external accounting partners across multiple
jurisdictions. Proficiency with accounting software and ERP systems;
experience with consolidation tools is a plus. Professional fluency in
English required; German at B2 level or above. Who you are: Sharp and
detail-oriented — you catch errors before they become problems and
take pride in numerical accuracy. Proactive and structured — you
manage your workload independently and flag issues early rather than
waiting to be asked. Reliable under deadlines — you understand that
close cycles have hard stops and you plan accordingly. Analytical
mindset — you don’t just process numbers, you understand what they
mean and can explain variances clearly. Collaborative spirit — you
work well with external partners and internal stakeholders across
different countries and functions. Bonus points if you have:
Experience with multi-entity set-up. Exposure to scaling finance
functions in a startup or fast-growth environment. Familiarity with
IFRS in addition to HGB. Experience with MOSS, Zoho Books and Atlar.
Why us? Leadership and Innovation: Work with a pioneering team
dedicated to transforming road logistics and contributing to a
sustainable future. Autonomy and Impact: We value innovation and give
you the freedom to grow in our team to make a significant impact.
Sustainability: Join a company where your work directly contributes to
reducing carbon emissions in logistics. Benefits : Join a great team
in our dog-friendly, hybrid work model with an office located at the
heart of Kreuzberg, where you’ll enjoy a relaxed, no-micromanagement
culture, regular company events, access to Urban Sports Club and L&D
budget, and an office stocked with snacks and drinks to keep you
energized. Our Company Values Think outside the truck: challenge the
internal-only status quo, prototype fast. Impact, not activity: cut
through noise, prioritize what actually matters. Own it: end-to-end
roadmap ownership, no safety net. Collaboration drives the core: daily
work with engineers, CEO, and CTO. Customer in the driver's seat:
internal or external, understand what they need. --- At JUNA, we value
authenticity, humility, and potential — so even if you don’t check
every box, we encourage you to apply. We know that diverse
backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences are what drive true
innovation. Our team is collaborative, international, and always
evolving. Come as you are — we’re excited to meet you and
hopefully welcome you on our journey to transform the logistics
industry across Europe. If you require accommodation during the hiring
process, please don’t hesitate to reach out to
mikaela.roennkvist@juna.com. Please only contact this email for
accommodation purposes.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES THE WHY At Blackwave, we develop and manufacture Composite Overwrapped Pressure Vessels and carbon fiber structures for the space industry — hardware where failure is not an option. As we scale from one site in Germany to two with our new facility in Texas, quality can't be an afterthought or a paper exercise. We're looking for a Quality Manager who builds a pragmatic, ISO 9001-compliant Quality Management System from the ground up for our Texas site, keeps our German QMS sharp, and creates a quality culture that engineers, operators, and management actually live — not one that gathers dust in a document folder. THE WHAT
• Own ISO 9001 at both sites: Maintain certification in Germany and establish it in Texas, preparing all audits — internal, certification, and customer — together with the teams so they're passed without major findings. Blackwave Code: High Performance
• Build processes people actually use: Define and implement essential quality processes that are pragmatic and scalable enough for development, manufacturing, and management to apply confidently in daily work. Blackwave Code: Togetherness
• Make performance visible: Give leadership clear, up-to-date visibility into company performance through meaningful KPIs and management reviews that drive decisions rather than just report numbers. Blackwave Code: Candor
• Own risk end-to-end: Establish and actively maintain a company-wide risk management system covering organizational, process, and product risks — with clear ownership and follow-up on mitigations. Blackwave Code: Accountability
• Digitize quality: Establish a digital QMS platform as the mandatory system of record, with quality documentation and workflows fully migrated and adopted across the organization. Blackwave Code: Playfulness

YOUR PROFILE
• 3–5+ years of experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment — you've stood on a shop floor, not just in an office
• Degree in a technical field (e.g. aerospace or mechanical engineering) plus relevant further training in quality management
• Hands-on ISO 9001 experience: you've managed audit cycles and can walk us through a process you set up yourself, end to end
• Pragmatic quality mindset: you build processes for usage, not just for compliance — standards are an enabler, not bureaucracy
• Builder mentality: you create structures from scratch rather than maintaining what's already there, and you see a bit of chaos as an opportunity
• Strong ownership and communication at all levels — from C-level to operator
• Fluent English is a must; German is a plus

WHAT WE OFFER
• Freedom to Create: Extensive decision-making freedom and short decision paths – we trust your expertise to lead your team.
• Fresh Fuel Every Day: Shared lunch breaks with freshly prepared, varied meals to keep the team energized.

In your daily work, you collaborate across functions including Engineering, Field Service, Procurement, Finance, Sales, and Onshore Project Management. Your ability to stay structured, build trust, and keep execution on track contributes directly to customer satisfaction and business success.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Project Ownership:Take full responsibility for the execution of assigned Gas Turbine LTP projects across the Asia Pacific region.
* Customer Success:Build strong customer relationships through reliable execution, transparent communication, and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
* Execution Excellence:Ensure delivery in line with project scope, schedule, cost, quality, and contractual requirements.
* Commercial Performance:Actively manage project cost, invoicing, cash flow, risks and opportunities, claims, and change order potential in close cooperation with Commercial Project Manager.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration:Work closely with Onshore Project Management, Engineering, Field Service, Procurement, Finance, and Sales to achieve project and business targets.
* Problem Solving:Identify risks and issues early, drive mitigation actions, and support timely resolution of technical, operational, and commercial topics.
* Continuous Improvement:Apply project management standards and tools with discipline and contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and ways of working.

What You Bring

* BS in Engineering or related field of study
* Significant professional experience in project management, ideally in Gas Turbine service business and/or Long-Term Program execution
* Strong technical and commercial understanding of project execution in the power generation industry
* Experience managing customer interfaces and coordinating cross-functional teams in an international business environment
* Strong communication skills and the ability to manage technical, operational, commercial, and customer-related topics in a structured and professional manner
* Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to manage priorities in a dynamic environment
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required
* Business proficiency in both German and English
* Project Management certification (e.g. IPMA, PMI or comparable) is considered an advantage

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme 
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder 
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity 
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programs and learning materials are available for this purpose 
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical   

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Security Compliance Lead (JCP) (m/f/d) (Cyber-Security-Consultant)
jobs.description:
What you’ll do 

As JetBrains expands its cloud and SaaS offerings, maintaining customer trust and robust security compliance is critical. We are investing in the security posture and compliance program for JetBrains Cloud Platform (JCP), a new JetBrains offering, moving beyond checklist-driven security to build practical, real-world controls.

In this role, you will take ownership of our compliance program from design to execution, focusing on SOC 2 and ISO standards. You’ll sit at the intersection of product security, platform engineering, legal, and customer-facing teams. Rather than imposing rigid bureaucracy, you’ll help design workflows that protect user data while keeping development teams fast and autonomous. You’ll also serve as a key technical voice on compliance matters, speaking directly with customers to explain our security architecture and build trust.

Day to day, you will:

- Design, implement, and mature the compliance program for JCP, focusing initially on SOC 2 (Type 1 and Type 2) and ISO standards (such as ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, and 42001).
- Translate complex framework requirements into clear, practical controls that fit how JetBrains builds products.
- Partner with product security, platform engineering, legal, and people teams to embed security and compliance requirements into day-to-day work (policies, procedures, onboarding, training, SDLC, vendor management, etc.).
- Coordinate evidence collection, control testing, and remediation for internal reviews and external audits.
- Maintain and improve core compliance documentation, including policies, standards, control catalogs, risk registers, and playbooks.
- Respond to customer security questionnaires, participate in due diligence calls, and collaborate with account teams to handle non-standard compliance requests.
- Monitor changes in relevant standards and regulations and help keep our program aligned with them.

What you’ll bring

- A practical mindset that values clear systems and real outcomes over rigid checklists.
- A clear, structured communication style that makes technical security concepts accessible to any audience.
- A detail-oriented approach with the curiosity to navigate both policy text and technical architecture.
- Calmness and confidence when guiding customers through security due diligence.

What you’ll need

- Established hands-on experience building and maturing compliance programs around SOC 2 and ISO security standards.
- Experience managing security compliance in SaaS or cloud environments (such as AWS, GCP, or Azure).
- Practical experience across core security and compliance domains, including access management, logging, secure development, vendor risk, and business continuity.
- A track record of collaborating effectively with technical teams (engineering, SRE, product security, etc.) and turning framework language into concrete, realistic requirements.
- Direct experience answering customer security questionnaires and leading customer-facing compliance discussions.
- Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.

It would be great if you also have:

- Experience with other frameworks and regulations relevant to SaaS, such as FedRAMP, ISMAP, or others.
- Experience working inside or closely with product security, cloud security, or risk management teams.
- Familiarity with security and compliance tooling (such as GRC platforms, ticketing systems, policy and evidence repositories, asset and identity management tools).
- Prior experience in a fast-growing or multi-product environment where processes and ownership boundaries are evolving.

What success looks like 

Success in this role means establishing a clear, reliable compliance foundation for JetBrains Cloud Platform that strengthens customer trust and respects engineering autonomy. You’ll know you’re succeeding when compliance controls feel like a natural part of product development, external audits run smoothly without last-minute scrambles, and customer security calls build lasting confidence in our platform.

**Why join JetBrains?** 

- Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
- Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
- Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.
- Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
- Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family
- Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
- Relocation support. We help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible. 
- Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.
- Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.
- Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.
- Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.
- Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

*Some benefits may vary depending on location.
